title: Zaragoza, Aragon — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

Zaragoza is a city in Aragon with a population of 675,000. A historic city on the Ebro River with two stunning cathedrals, Roman ruins, and a lively tapas culture. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
